description: The file defines the RetrieveConnectionLogs class, which represents a command to retrieve logs for a specific connection within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances from JSON and for serializing the command payload, along with relevant metadata and annotations.

classes.name: RetrieveConnectionLogs
classes.description: A command class to retrieve logs associated with a specific connection in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It encapsulates the connection ID, headers, and provides mechanisms for JSON serialization and deserialization, as well as command metadata.

methods.name: RetrieveConnectionLogs.of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of RetrieveConnectionLogs with the specified connection ID and headers.

methods.name: RetrieveConnectionLogs.fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a RetrieveConnectionLogs object from a JSON string or object and headers.

methods.name: getConnectionEntityId
methods.description: Returns the connection ID associated with this command.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is QUERY.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path for the logs resource.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of the command with the specified headers.
